name: NHS inform — diagnosing autistic children
description: NHS inform guidance for Scotland on concerns that a child may be autistic and access to local neurodevelopmental assessment pathways.
intended_use: Use as the national Scotland-facing starting route when a parent/carer or supporter is considering autism assessment for a child.
audience_or_context: Children, parents/carers, schools and supporters in Scotland.
limitations: Local neurodevelopmental referral pathways and waiting times vary by area.
The page describes assessment access and cannot diagnose a child.
cost_or_access_notes: Publicly accessible online; NHS access depends on local pathways.
conflicts_of_interest: NHS inform is Scotland's national health information service; ND Oracle records the official route without assuming local availability or outcome.

provenance.method: Current NHS inform child autism diagnosis page checked on 2026-09-03 for GP, health-visitor/school and local neurodevelopmental pathway wording. Listing is descriptive and claimless.
